invariants.rule: Compatibility never branches on species identity/name; current structural/capability/owner projections are the inputs.
Scale may be one explicit requirement but size/category alone cannot determine compatibility.
Every incompatible result identifies explicit unmet requirements and an owner/source-traceable reason.
Missing, source-unspecified, conflicted or unauthorized required facts yield unresolved rather than fabricated fit or rejection.
compatible_with_adapter requires explicit adapter Definition references; MVPS-07 never synthesizes, grants, owns or installs adapters.
Compatibility evaluation is side-effect-free and cannot equip, install, attune, bond, seat, board, assign or otherwise mutate owning-domain state.
Structural mount/rider fit never creates mount eligibility, partnership, training, consent, workload, ownership or relationship state; CCP/mount owners remain authoritative.
Vehicle-seat/control-interface compatibility never assigns passenger/station state or grants control; PPIA-04/F014 remains authoritative.
MVPS-07 evaluates referenced definitions/projections and does not create Item Definitions, Asset Instances, ownership or inventory state.
Current form/body projection may change compatibility inputs, but form/transformation semantics remain MVPS-09.
